2609.21755.title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
2609.21755.paper_summary: Emergency department (ED) decision-making relies on heterogeneous clinical information, including patient history, vital signs, laboratory results, and electrocardiograms (ECGs). Vision--language models (VLMs) can jointly process these modalities, but strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply meaningful use of the correct patient's ECG. We term this failure mode ECG Mirage: apparent multimodal capability without useful dependence on patient-specific ECG information. We distinguish two forms: ECG neglect, where ECGs provide little predictive benefit, and ECG confusion, where matched ECGs outperform no-image inputs but not mismatched ECGs. To evaluate these behaviours, we compare predictions obtained with matched ECGs, outcome-discordant mismatched ECGs, and no-image inputs while holding the clinical text and prediction targets fixed. Across four VLMs on MDS-ED, matched ECGs provide no consistent advantage for either ICU admission or clinical deterioration prediction. We then train four restricted visual prompts using supervised learning followed by conditional direct preference optimisation, while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. The resulting models achieve balanced accuracies of 70.6% for ICU admission and 67.5% for deterioration and increase the matched-versus-mismatched performance gap to approximately 16.5 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively. Overall, our study identifies ECG Mirage in multimodal clinical prediction and introduces visual prompt tuning as an efficient mitigation strategy.
2609.21755.paper_summary_zh: 急診部門（ED）的決策依賴於異質的臨床信息，包括病史、生命體徵、實驗室結果和心電圖（ECG）。視覺-語言模型（VLMs）可以共同處理這些模態，但強大的預測性能並不一定意味著正確使用患者的ECG。我們將這種失敗模式稱為ECG幻影：表面上的多模態能力卻沒有對患者特定ECG信息的有用依賴。我們區分兩種形式：ECG忽視，ECG提供的預測效益很小；以及ECG混淆，匹配的ECG在預測上優於無圖像輸入，但不如不匹配的ECG。為了評估這些行為，我們比較了使用匹配ECG、結果不一致的不匹配ECG和無圖像輸入所獲得的預測，同時保持臨床文本和預測目標不變。在四個VLMs的MDS-ED上，匹配的ECG對於ICU入院或臨床惡化預測並未提供一致的優勢。然後，我們使用監督學習訓練四個限制性視覺提示，隨後進行條件直接偏好優化，同時保持VLM主幹不變。最終模型在ICU入院的平衡準確率達到70.6%，在惡化的準確率為67.5%，並將匹配與不匹配的性能差距分別增大至約16.5和5.5個百分點。總體而言，我們的研究在多模態臨床預測中識別了ECG幻影，並引入視覺提示調整作為一種有效的緩解策略。
